info.title: Tablz API
info.description: Tablz restaurant management API, Backend Phase 1. Every error response is `{ code, message, details }`.

isDemo.description: Phase 1: only the demo restaurant accepts changes.

branchId.description: Null when an ADMIN of a multi-branch restaurant has not chosen a branch.

available.description: False when the branch's stock cannot make one serving (show greyed out). Ordering is not blocked in Phase 1 (ADR 0006, ADR 0021).

categories.description: Active categories with at least one visible item, in display order.

isActive.description: False = archived: its items are hidden from the customer menu.

position.description: Defaults to after the last category.

isActive.description: False archives the category, true brings it back.

inventoryItemId.description: An active inventory item of this restaurant.

quantity.description: Per one menu item, in `unit`. Positive; at most 3 decimals after conversion.

unit.description: Same dimension as the item's stock unit (ADR 0003).

categoryId.description: An active category of this restaurant.

branchId.description: Only this branch sells it; null or absent = every branch.

ingredients.description: Replaces the whole recipe. Leave it out to keep the current one.

quantityPerUnit.description: Per one unit of the MIXED item.

expectedStock.description: Latest count + ledger since (ARCHITECTURE §5). Equals currentStock (the ledger keeps them in step); a write landing between the reads of one response can show them apart. Null for MIXED.

derivedStock.description: MIXED only: how many units its components allow (ADR 0002).

components.description: MIXED only, sorted by component name; empty otherwise.

expectedStock.description: Latest count + ledger since (ARCHITECTURE §5). Equals currentStock (the ledger keeps them in step); a write landing between the reads of one response can show them apart. Null for MIXED.

derivedStock.description: MIXED only: how many units its components allow (ADR 0002).

components.description: MIXED only, sorted by component name; empty otherwise.

changeSinceLastCount.description: Sum of ledger rows since the latest count (or since the start).

quantity.description: Positive, in `unit` (defaults to the stock unit).

unit.description: Same dimension as the item's stock unit.

unitCost.description: Cost per entered unit (converted to the stock unit). Optional: without it the moving average is unchanged.
Stored on the row, per stock unit.

key.description: A key of the restaurant's workflow (tenant data, not an enum). Defaults: `pending`, `in-preparation`, `ready`, `delivered` (ADR 0009).

position.description: Orders move to the next higher position.

cancellable.description: An order on this stage may be cancelled.

deductsInventory.description: Reaching this stage deducts the order from inventory (once).

menuItemId.description: An active menu item sold in this branch (see the customer menu).

items.description: Name and price are copied from the menu; the client never sends prices.

actorType.description: Phase 1: GUEST, or STAFF for a staff caller.

name.description: Copied when the order was placed.

stageKey.description: A key of the restaurant's workflow (tenant data, not an enum). Defaults: `pending`, `in-preparation`, `ready`, `delivered` (ADR 0009).

status.description: `cancelled` when `canceledAt` is set, else `stageKey` (ADR 0009). Display only.

trackingToken.description: Guest orders only: the secret for tracking and cancelling (ADR 0008). Returned once, never stored in plain form; keep it. null for staff orders.

stageKey.description: A key of the restaurant's workflow (tenant data, not an enum). Defaults: `pending`, `in-preparation`, `ready`, `delivered` (ADR 0009).

status.description: `cancelled` when `canceledAt` is set, else `stageKey` (ADR 0009). Display only.

inventoryItemId.description: An active RAW or READY item of this restaurant (MIXED items have no stock).

quantity.description: As entered, in `unit`. Positive; at most 3 decimals in the stock unit.

unit.description: Same dimension as the item's stock unit (ADR 0003).

reason.description: Free text, trimmed. The app offers preset reasons as chips.

transactionId.description: Its WASTE row in the inventory ledger.

quantityDelta.description: The stock change, negative, in the item's stock unit.

stockAfter.description: The branch's stock right after, in the stock unit. May be negative.

negative.description: True when stock is now below zero (allowed and flagged, ADR 0006).

code.description: Stable machine-readable code the frontend switches on.

message.description: Human-readable summary. Do not parse it.

details.description: Machine-readable context. VALIDATION_FAILED: `{ fields: [{ field, messages }] }`.
